newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul foreign minister tenders resignation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul foreign minister tenders resignation.

text.p: South Korean Foreign Minister Gong Ro-myung on Tuesday offered his resignation to President Kim Young-sam, citing poor health, a foreign ministry spokesman said.
"Minister Gong tendered a resignation through Prime Minister Lee Soo-sung on health reason," the spokesman said.
"The minister has been admitted to a Seoul hospital."
He gave no further details on Gong's health condition but the domestic Yonhap news agency said he had been treated for high blood pressure.
An official at the presidential office said Kim had not decided to accept the resignation.
Gong, 64, had a good relationship with Kim long before Kim rose to power.
